title: Refine the 80 WRONG verdicts of the A001 v4 citation audit to genuine off-by-N candidates
final_text:
Done. Summary of the work:

**Verified hash**: `docs/sources/FW5-explanatory-construction.md` sha256 matches `8105925b…ee63a` (computed, recorded in both outputs).

**Method** (all computed by `check/refine.py`, nothing transcribed): loaded the 80 WRONG rows from `staging/citations-v4-first-pass.json`, recovered each staging line and its failed fragments, re-attributed each fragment by locating every source line containing it (typographic quotes/whitespace/Cf characters normalised), and classified:

- **42 RESOLVED-BY-SIBLING** — the fragment is verbatim at the target of another citation on the same staging line (the first pass's known attribution ambiguity).
- **30 NOT-A-QUOTE** — the fragment occurs nowhere in the source and is staging/A001 notation: a relaxed subscript-brace/`\mathrm`-flattening match located the substantive LaTeX source lines (e.g. `\operatorname{Ans}p(a,b)=…`) or identified audit bookkeeping (labels, paths, headings).
- **8 CANDIDATE rows → 4 distinct fragments**, refined to:
  - **OFF-BY-N (2)**: staging 797 `:1372` quotes the section title at source 1370 (off by −2); staging 1138 `:1202` quotes "the stipulated bijections" at source 1206 (off by +4).
  - **TAG-CONVENTION (1)**: staging 160 `:947` cites the `\tag{CT2}` line while quoting the section/heading material just above it (source 941).
  - **UNRESOLVED (1)**: staging 847 `:893` quotes `\operatorname{Bearing}(c,z,p)`, which occurs only at source line 614 — 279 lines away, too far and off-tag for a clean off-by-N re-attribution; an authorial question.

**Files written**: `check/refine.py`, `out/citations-v4-refined.json`, `out/citations-v4-refined.md` (591 lines, with per-row classification, full candidate reports including 160-char line excerpts, full OFF-BY-N/UNRESOLVED lists, and the stated limit: computation cannot decide whether a citation was meant to name the tag line or the display body).

**Last test run**: `python3 -c` verification of the outputs — OK, exit 0 (80 rows, 4 candidates, counts as above, all required sections present).
